rice.season: Kharif (main); also grown as Rabi/boro rice in eastern India under assured irrigation.
rice.climate: Warm humid climate, 20-37 C, requires 100-200 cm rainfall or equivalent irrigation.
rice.soil: Clayey loam to clay with good water-holding capacity, pH 5.5-6.5; puddled lowland soils are ideal.
rice.sowing_time: Nursery sowing May-June, transplanting June-July (Kharif); direct-seeded rice sown with monsoon onset.
rice.seed_rate: Transplanted rice: 20-25 kg/ha nursery seed; direct-seeded rice: 25-30 kg/ha.
rice.spacing: 20 cm x 15 cm, 2-3 seedlings per hill.
rice.irrigation: Maintain 2-5 cm standing water; critical stages are tillering, panicle initiation and flowering; drain field 7-10 days before harvest.
rice.fertilizer_schedule: 120:60:40 NPK kg/ha; full P and K plus 1/3 N basal at transplanting, remaining N in two equal splits at tillering and panicle initiation.
rice.major_pests_diseases: Stem borer, brown planthopper, leaf folder; blast, bacterial leaf blight, sheath blight.
rice.harvest: Harvest at 80-85% grain maturity when moisture is around 20-22%, Oct-Nov for Kharif crop.
rice.improved_varieties: Pusa Basmati 1509, Swarna, MTU 1010, IR 64, Pusa 44, Sahbhagi Dhan (drought-tolerant).

maize.season: Kharif (main); also grown in Rabi and Zaid (spring) under irrigation.
maize.climate: Warm season crop, 21-27 C optimum; sensitive to frost, waterlogging and drought at flowering.
maize.soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam, pH 5.5-7.5; avoid poorly drained fields.
maize.sowing_time: Kharif: June-July with monsoon onset; Rabi: mid-Oct to mid-Nov; spring: Jan-Feb.
maize.seed_rate: 20-25 kg/ha for grain maize; 8-10 kg/ha for hybrids at wider spacing.
maize.irrigation: Rainfed with supplemental irrigation in Kharif; Rabi/spring needs 8-10 irrigations, critical at knee-high, tasseling and grain-filling.
maize.fertilizer_schedule: 120:60:40 NPK kg/ha; 1/3 N plus full P and K basal, remaining N in two splits at knee-high and tasseling.
maize.major_pests_diseases: Fall armyworm, stem borer, shoot fly; turcicum leaf blight, maydis leaf blight, stalk rot.
maize.harvest: 90-110 days; harvest at 20-25% grain moisture for grain purpose.
maize.improved_varieties: DHM 117, PMH 1, HQPM 1, Pioneer 30V92, Pusa Composite 4.

jute.season: Kharif fibre crop, mainly grown in West Bengal, Bihar, Assam and Odisha.
jute.climate: Hot humid climate, 24-37 C, requires 150-250 cm well-distributed rainfall.
jute.soil: New alluvial soil of river basins, well-drained loam, pH 6.0-7.5.
jute.sowing_time: Late March to mid-May (Capsularis and Olitorius types sown by mid-April).
jute.seed_rate: 5-6 kg/ha broadcast sowing; 4-5 kg/ha line sowing.
jute.spacing: Lines 25-30 cm apart, thinned to 5-8 cm plant to plant.
jute.irrigation: Mostly rainfed; a light irrigation is given if rains are delayed at germination.
jute.fertilizer_schedule: 60:30:30 NPK kg/ha; N applied in two splits at 20-25 and 40-45 DAS, P and K basal.
jute.major_pests_diseases: Jute semilooper, stem weevil, yellow mite; stem rot, black band disease.
jute.harvest: 120-150 days after sowing at small pod stage for best fibre quality; retted in water for 15-20 days.

cotton.season: Kharif crop; irrigated cotton is a long-duration crop in central and south India.
cotton.climate: Warm frost-free climate 21-30 C for 180-200 days, moderate rainfall 50-100 cm.
cotton.soil: Deep black cotton soil (regur) and alluvial soils, well-drained, pH 6.0-8.0.
cotton.sowing_time: April-May (irrigated, North zone); June-July (rainfed, Central/South zone) with monsoon onset.
cotton.seed_rate: 1.5-2.0 kg/ha for Bt hybrids using delinted seed.
cotton.spacing: 90-120 cm x 45-60 cm for hybrids; closer spacing used for high-density planting varieties.
cotton.irrigation: 6-8 irrigations for irrigated crop; critical at square formation, flowering and boll development.
cotton.fertilizer_schedule: 100-150:50-60:50-60 NPK kg/ha for hybrids; N applied in 3-4 splits, P and K basal.
cotton.major_pests_diseases: Pink bollworm, whitefly, jassid, thrips; bacterial blight, Fusarium wilt, grey mildew.
cotton.harvest: 150-180 days; picking done in 3-4 rounds as bolls burst, Oct-Jan.
cotton.expected_yield: 15-20 q/ha seed cotton rainfed; 25-30 q/ha irrigated hybrid.
cotton.improved_varieties: Bunny Bt, RCH 2 Bt, Bikaneri Narma, MCU 5 (non-Bt), Suraj.

coconut.season: Perennial plantation crop; planting done at monsoon onset.
coconut.climate: Tropical humid climate, 27-32 C, well-distributed rainfall 100-230 cm.
coconut.soil: Sandy loam to laterite coastal soils, well-drained, pH 5.2-8.0.
coconut.sowing_time: Planting of seedlings May-June (monsoon onset) or Sept-Oct.
coconut.spacing: 7.5 m x 7.5 m (square system) for tall varieties.
coconut.irrigation: 40 litres/palm/week in summer if irrigated; drip irrigation with 20-30 litres/day improves yield.
coconut.fertilizer_schedule: 500 g N, 320 g P2O5, 1200 g K2O per palm per year in two splits, with 25-50 kg organic manure/palm.
coconut.major_pests_diseases: Rhinoceros beetle, red palm weevil, eriophyid mite; bud rot, root wilt disease.
coconut.harvest: First bearing in 5-6 years; nuts mature 12 months after spathe opening, harvested every 45-60 days.
coconut.improved_varieties: West Coast Tall, Chowghat Orange Dwarf, Kera Chandra (T x D hybrid).

papaya.season: Grown year-round; best planting Feb-March and June-July.
papaya.soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.0; sensitive to waterlogging.
papaya.sowing_time: Nursery raising in poly bags, transplanting Feb-March or Sept-Oct.
papaya.seed_rate: 300-400 g seed/ha for raising about 2000 plants/ha.
papaya.irrigation: Drip irrigation preferred; irrigate every 3-4 days in summer, avoid waterlogging.
papaya.fertilizer_schedule: 250:250:500 g NPK/plant/year in monthly split doses with 10 kg FYM/plant.
papaya.major_pests_diseases: Papaya mealybug, fruit fly, aphid (virus vector); papaya ring spot virus, powdery mildew, foot rot.
papaya.harvest: First harvest 9-11 months after planting; fruits picked at colour-break stage.
papaya.improved_varieties: Pusa Delicious, Red Lady 786, Taiwan 786, CO 7, Pusa Nanha.

orange.season: Perennial; two flowering flushes - Ambia (Jan-Feb) and Mrig (June-July).
orange.climate: Subtropical, 13-37 C, sensitive to frost during flowering.
orange.soil: Deep well-drained loam, pH 5.5-7.5; avoid waterlogged/saline soils.
orange.sowing_time: Planting of grafted saplings June-Aug or Feb-March.
orange.irrigation: Drip irrigation preferred, 15-20 irrigations/year; a stress period before Mrig bahar improves flowering.
orange.fertilizer_schedule: 600-800 g N, 200-300 g P2O5, 200-300 g K2O per bearing tree per year, split in 2-3 doses.
orange.major_pests_diseases: Citrus psylla, leaf miner, fruit-sucking moth; citrus canker, gummosis, greening (Huanglongbing).
orange.harvest: First bearing in 4-5 years; fruits mature 8-10 months after flowering, Nov-Jan for Nagpur mandarin.
orange.improved_varieties: Nagpur Mandarin, Kinnow, Coorg Mandarin, Mosambi (sweet orange).

apple.season: Perennial temperate fruit; flowering March-April, requires winter chilling.
apple.climate: Temperate climate needing 1000-1600 chilling hours below 7 C; summer temperature 21-24 C.
apple.sowing_time: Planting of grafted plants during dormant season, Dec-Feb.
apple.seed_rate: 250-1250 grafted plants/ha depending on rootstock (standard to high-density).
apple.spacing: 5 m x 5 m standard; 1-3 m x 3-4 m for high-density on dwarfing rootstock (M9, MM106).
apple.irrigation: 10-12 irrigations/year; critical at fruit set and fruit development.
apple.fertilizer_schedule: 500-600 g N, 250 g P2O5, 500 g K2O per bearing tree per year, applied before flowering and post-harvest.
apple.major_pests_diseases: Woolly apple aphid, San Jose scale, codling moth; apple scab, powdery mildew, collar rot.
apple.harvest: Bearing starts 4-5 years after planting; fruits mature July-September depending on variety.
apple.improved_varieties: Royal Delicious, Red Delicious, Golden Delicious, Fuji, HRMN 99 (low-chill).

muskmelon.season: Zaid (summer) crop; also grown as a riverbed crop.
muskmelon.climate: Warm dry climate, 24-27 C optimum; sensitive to frost and high humidity.
muskmelon.soil: Sandy loam, well-drained, pH 6.5-7.5; sandy river-bed soils are ideal.
muskmelon.spacing: 2 m x 0.6 m on raised beds/pits.
muskmelon.irrigation: Irrigate every 5-7 days; critical at flowering and fruit development, avoid water stress.
muskmelon.fertilizer_schedule: 100:50:50 NPK kg/ha; half N and full P, K basal, remaining N at vine spread and flowering.
muskmelon.major_pests_diseases: Fruit fly, red pumpkin beetle, aphid; powdery mildew, downy mildew, fusarium wilt.
muskmelon.harvest: 80-100 days after sowing; harvest at full slip/aroma stage.
muskmelon.improved_varieties: Punjab Sunehri, Pusa Sharbati, Hara Madhu, Arka Jeet.

watermelon.season: Zaid (summer) crop; also grown on riverbeds in winter.
watermelon.climate: Hot dry climate, 24-30 C optimum, intolerant of frost.
watermelon.soil: Sandy loam to sandy soil with good drainage, pH 6.0-7.0.
watermelon.sowing_time: January-March in plains (Zaid); Oct-Nov on riverbeds.
watermelon.irrigation: Irrigate every 6-8 days; withhold irrigation 1-2 weeks before harvest to improve sweetness.
watermelon.fertilizer_schedule: 80-100:50:50 NPK kg/ha; half N and full P,K basal, remaining N top-dressed at vining and flowering.
watermelon.major_pests_diseases: Fruit fly, red pumpkin beetle, aphid; anthracnose, downy mildew, fusarium wilt.
watermelon.harvest: 80-90 days after sowing; harvest when ground spot turns yellow and the nearby tendril dries.
watermelon.improved_varieties: Sugar Baby, Arka Manik, Durgapura Meetha, Asahi Yamato.

grapes.season: Perennial; pruned twice a year, main harvest Jan-March in peninsular India.
grapes.climate: Semi-arid subtropical climate, warm dry weather during ripening; sensitive to rain during fruiting.
grapes.soil: Deep well-drained loam to sandy loam, pH 6.5-7.5.
grapes.sowing_time: Planting of rooted cuttings June-July or Feb-March.
grapes.seed_rate: 1600-2200 rooted cuttings/ha depending on training system.
grapes.spacing: 3 m x 1.5-2 m under bower or Y-trellis system.
grapes.irrigation: Drip irrigation preferred; regulated deficit irrigation during ripening improves quality.
grapes.fertilizer_schedule: 500-800 g N, 250-500 g P2O5, 500-1000 g K2O per vine per year in split doses tied to the pruning cycle.
grapes.major_pests_diseases: Thrips, mealybug, flea beetle; downy mildew, powdery mildew, anthracnose.
grapes.harvest: First bearing 2-3 years after planting; harvested Jan-March after foundation and fruit pruning.
grapes.improved_varieties: Thompson Seedless, Sonaka, Sharad Seedless, Bangalore Blue.

mango.climate: Tropical/subtropical; dry weather during flowering favours fruit set, sensitive to frost.
mango.soil: Deep well-drained alluvial to laterite loam, pH 5.5-7.5.
mango.sowing_time: Planting of grafted plants July-Aug (rainfed) or Feb-March (irrigated).
mango.seed_rate: 100-400 grafted plants/ha depending on spacing (traditional to high-density).
mango.spacing: 10 m x 10 m traditional; 5 m x 5 m for high-density planting.
mango.irrigation: Irrigate at 10-15 day intervals during fruit development; withhold irrigation before flowering to induce stress-flowering.
mango.fertilizer_schedule: 1-1.5 kg N, 0.5 kg P2O5, 1 kg K2O per bearing tree per year, applied post-harvest and before flowering.
mango.major_pests_diseases: Mango hopper, mealybug, fruit fly; powdery mildew, anthracnose, malformation.
mango.harvest: Bearing starts 4-5 years after grafting; fruits mature 3-4.5 months after fruit set, April-July.
mango.improved_varieties: Alphonso, Dashehari, Langra, Kesar, Amrapali, Mallika.

banana.season: Grown year-round; main planting June-July and Oct-Nov.
banana.climate: Tropical humid climate, 15-35 C, needs protection from strong winds and frost.
banana.soil: Deep, fertile, well-drained loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.5.
banana.sowing_time: Planting of tissue-culture suckers/plantlets June-July or Oct-Nov.
banana.spacing: 1.8 m x 1.8 m to 2 m x 2 m.
banana.irrigation: Drip irrigation preferred, 15-20 litres/plant/day in summer; highly sensitive to water stress.
banana.fertilizer_schedule: 200:60:200 g NPK/plant/year applied through fertigation in 5-6 split doses.
banana.major_pests_diseases: Banana weevil, pseudostem borer, aphid (virus vector); Panama wilt (Fusarium), Sigatoka leaf spot, bunchy top virus.
banana.harvest: 10-12 months after planting; harvest at 75-80% maturity (3/4 round fingers) for distant markets.
banana.improved_varieties: Grand Naine, Robusta, Poovan, Nendran, Rasthali.

pomegranate.season: Perennial; flowered as Ambe (Jan-Feb), Mrig (June-July) or Hasta (Sept-Oct) bahar.
pomegranate.climate: Semi-arid, dry climate, 25-35 C optimum, tolerant of drought and mild frost.
pomegranate.soil: Deep loamy to medium black soil, well-drained, pH 6.5-7.5; tolerant of moderate salinity.
pomegranate.sowing_time: Planting of rooted cuttings/grafts June-July or Feb-March.
pomegranate.spacing: 4.5 m x 3 m or 5 m x 5 m.
pomegranate.irrigation: Drip irrigation, 4-8 litres/plant/day; irrigation withheld 20-25 days before bahar treatment for uniform flowering.
pomegranate.fertilizer_schedule: 625 g N, 250 g P2O5, 250 g K2O per bearing plant per year with 10-20 kg FYM, applied in split doses.
pomegranate.major_pests_diseases: Fruit borer, thrips, fruit-sucking moth; bacterial blight (Xanthomonas), wilt, fruit rot.
pomegranate.harvest: Bearing starts 2-3 years after planting; fruits mature 5-7 months after flowering.

lentil.season: Rabi crop, mainly grown as a pulse in North and Central India.
lentil.climate: Cool dry climate, 18-30 C, sensitive to frost at flowering and to waterlogging.
lentil.soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam, pH 6.0-7.5.
lentil.irrigation: Mostly grown on residual moisture; one irrigation at pre-flowering/pod-formation stage if available.
lentil.fertilizer_schedule: 20:40:20 NPK kg/ha, all basal at sowing; seed inoculation with Rhizobium recommended.
lentil.major_pests_diseases: Aphid, pod borer; rust, wilt, Ascochyta blight.
lentil.harvest: 110-130 days; harvest when pods turn brown and dry, Feb-March.
lentil.improved_varieties: Pusa Vaibhav, DPL 62 (Asha), IPL 316, Pant Masur 639.

blackgram.season: Kharif (main) and Rabi/summer (Zaid) in South India.
blackgram.climate: Warm humid climate, 25-35 C, sensitive to waterlogging and frost.
blackgram.soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam, pH 6.5-7.5.
blackgram.irrigation: Rainfed in Kharif; summer crop needs irrigation every 10-12 days, critical at flowering and pod filling.
blackgram.fertilizer_schedule: 20:40:20 NPK kg/ha basal; seed treatment with Rhizobium and PSB culture.
blackgram.major_pests_diseases: Whitefly (yellow mosaic virus vector), pod borer, thrips; yellow mosaic virus, Cercospora leaf spot, powdery mildew.
blackgram.harvest: 70-90 days; harvest when 80% pods turn black and dry.
blackgram.improved_varieties: Pant U 31, Pant U 19, TAU 1, WBU 108, Uttara.

mungbean.season: Grown in Kharif, summer (Zaid) and spring seasons depending on region.
mungbean.climate: Warm climate, 25-35 C, short-duration crop sensitive to frost and waterlogging.
mungbean.soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam, pH 6.5-7.5.
mungbean.irrigation: Rainfed in Kharif; summer crop needs 4-5 irrigations at 10-12 day intervals, critical at flowering and pod development.
mungbean.fertilizer_schedule: 20:40:20 NPK kg/ha basal; seed treatment with Rhizobium culture.
mungbean.major_pests_diseases: Whitefly (yellow mosaic virus vector), thrips, pod borer; yellow mosaic virus, Cercospora leaf spot, powdery mildew.
mungbean.harvest: 60-75 days; 2-3 pickings as pods mature and turn black.
mungbean.improved_varieties: Pusa Vishal, SML 668, IPM 2-3 (Virat), Samrat, Pusa 1431.

mothbeans.season: Kharif crop, a hardy drought-tolerant pulse of arid regions.
mothbeans.climate: Hot arid climate, tolerant of high temperature and low rainfall (25-50 cm).
mothbeans.soil: Sandy to sandy loam soils of low fertility, pH 6.0-8.0, tolerant of poor soils.
mothbeans.sowing_time: June-July with the onset of monsoon.
mothbeans.irrigation: Purely rainfed; extremely drought-tolerant, no irrigation normally needed.
mothbeans.fertilizer_schedule: 10-20:20-40:0 NPK kg/ha basal, reflecting low fertility requirement.
mothbeans.major_pests_diseases: Aphid, pod borer, whitefly; yellow mosaic virus, bacterial leaf spot, powdery mildew.
mothbeans.harvest: 75-90 days; harvest when pods dry and turn brown.

pigeonpeas.climate: Warm climate 20-30 C, moderate rainfall 60-100 cm, sensitive to waterlogging and frost.
pigeonpeas.soil: Deep well-drained loam to clay loam, pH 6.5-7.5.
pigeonpeas.seed_rate: 15-20 kg/ha sole crop; 8-10 kg/ha as intercrop.
pigeonpeas.spacing: 60-75 cm x 20-30 cm for short-duration types; 90-120 cm x 30 cm for long-duration types.
pigeonpeas.irrigation: Mostly rainfed; 1-2 protective irrigations at flowering and pod filling if available.
pigeonpeas.fertilizer_schedule: 20-25:50:20 NPK kg/ha basal; Rhizobium seed treatment recommended.
pigeonpeas.major_pests_diseases: Pod borer (Helicoverpa), pod fly; Fusarium wilt, sterility mosaic disease.
pigeonpeas.harvest: 150-180 days for medium-duration types; harvest when 80% pods dry, Dec-Feb.

kidneybeans.season: Kharif crop in hills, Rabi crop in plains.
kidneybeans.climate: Cool climate 15-25 C; grown as Kharif crop in hills and Rabi crop in plains.
kidneybeans.soil: Well-drained loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.5.
kidneybeans.irrigation: 4-5 irrigations in plains; critical at flowering and pod formation; hill crop mostly rainfed.
kidneybeans.fertilizer_schedule: 20:60:40 NPK kg/ha; full dose basal, light N top-dress at flowering if needed.
kidneybeans.major_pests_diseases: Aphid, pod borer, bean fly; anthracnose, angular leaf spot, bean common mosaic virus.
kidneybeans.harvest: 90-120 days; harvest when pods dry and rattle.
kidneybeans.improved_varieties: PDR 14, Uttara, VL Rajma 63, HUR 15, Arka Suvidha.

chickpea.season: Rabi crop, a major pulse of Central and North India.
chickpea.climate: Cool dry climate, 20-25 C, sensitive to excess moisture and frost at flowering.
chickpea.soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam, pH 6.0-7.5.
chickpea.sowing_time: Mid-October to mid-November; irrigated crop can be sown up to end of November.
chickpea.irrigation: Mostly rainfed on residual moisture; one irrigation at pre-flowering/pod-development stage if irrigated.
chickpea.fertilizer_schedule: 20:40-60:20 NPK kg/ha, all basal; Rhizobium and PSB seed treatment recommended.
chickpea.major_pests_diseases: Pod borer (Helicoverpa armigera), cutworm; Fusarium wilt, Ascochyta blight, dry root rot.
chickpea.harvest: 120-150 days; harvest when plants dry and leaves shed, Feb-March.
chickpea.improved_varieties: Pusa 372, JG 11, KAK 2, Vijay, GNG 1581, Pusa Kabuli 1003 (BGD 1003).

coffee.season: Perennial plantation crop; flowering after summer/blossom showers (Feb-Apr), harvest Nov-Feb.
coffee.climate: Sub-tropical hilly climate under shade, 15-28 C, rainfall 150-250 cm well distributed.
coffee.soil: Deep, well-drained lateritic/loamy soil rich in organic matter, pH 5.0-6.5, on hill slopes.
coffee.sowing_time: Planting of nursery-raised seedlings June-July at monsoon onset.
coffee.spacing: 1.8-2 m x 1.8-2 m (Arabica); 2.4-3 m x 2.4-3 m (Robusta) under shade trees.
coffee.irrigation: Rainfed under shade; supplemental irrigation during dry spells and for blossom/backing showers.
coffee.fertilizer_schedule: Arabica: about 110:110:110 g NPK/plant/year; Robusta higher dose; applied in 2-3 splits before and after monsoon.
coffee.major_pests_diseases: Coffee berry borer, white stem borer, mealybug; coffee leaf rust, berry disease (Colletotrichum).
coffee.harvest: Bearing starts 3-4 years after planting; berries hand-picked in 3-4 rounds Nov-Feb (Arabica), Jan-Mar (Robusta).
coffee.expected_yield: 800-1200 kg clean coffee/ha at full bearing.
coffee.improved_varieties: Arabica: S.795, Selection 9, Cauvery (Catimor); Robusta: CxR, S.274.

wheat.climate: Cool growing period 15-22 C, warm sunny period at grain filling; frost tolerant but sensitive at flowering.
wheat.soil: Well-drained loam to clay loam, pH 6.5-7.5.
wheat.sowing_time: 1-25 November in North India; late sowing after 15 Dec cuts yield.
wheat.irrigation: 5-6 irrigations; critical at crown root initiation (21 DAS), tillering, jointing, flowering, milk and dough stages.
wheat.fertilizer_schedule: 120:60:40 NPK kg/ha; full P and K plus 1/3 N basal, remaining N in two splits at first and second irrigation.
wheat.major_pests_diseases: Yellow rust, loose smut, Karnal bunt; aphids, termites.
wheat.harvest: Harvest at physiological maturity (grain moisture ~20%), March-April.

sugarcane.season: Long-duration crop (10-18 months); planted in spring, autumn or maintained as ratoon.
sugarcane.climate: Tropical/subtropical, 21-27 C growth optimum, needs high sunshine and 75-150 cm water.
sugarcane.soil: Deep, well-drained loam to clay loam, pH 6.5-7.5, with high water and nutrient demand.
sugarcane.sowing_time: Spring: Feb-March; Autumn: Sept-Oct; Adsali (Maharashtra): July-Aug.
sugarcane.spacing: Rows 90-120 cm apart; up to 150 cm for trench planting.
sugarcane.irrigation: 20-25 irrigations depending on season and soil; critical at germination, tillering and grand growth stage.
sugarcane.fertilizer_schedule: 250-300:80-100:100-120 NPK kg/ha; N in 3-4 splits, P basal, K in two splits.
sugarcane.major_pests_diseases: Early shoot borer, top borer, pyrilla; red rot, smut, wilt.
sugarcane.harvest: 10-12 months (spring), 12-18 months (adsali); harvest at peak sucrose maturity, Nov-March.

soybean.season: Kharif crop, a major oilseed of Central India (Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra).
soybean.climate: Warm humid climate, 20-30 C, needs 60-100 cm well-distributed rainfall.
soybean.soil: Well-drained medium black soil, pH 6.0-7.5; avoid waterlogging-prone fields.
soybean.sowing_time: Last week of June to first week of July, with monsoon onset.
soybean.seed_rate: 65-80 kg/ha of bold-seeded varieties, adjusted for germination percentage.
soybean.irrigation: Mostly rainfed; 1-2 protective irrigations at flowering and pod filling if dry spell occurs.
soybean.fertilizer_schedule: 20-30:60-80:20-40 NPK kg/ha, all basal; Rhizobium japonicum and PSB seed treatment essential.
soybean.major_pests_diseases: Girdle beetle, stem fly, defoliators; yellow mosaic virus, rust, Rhizoctonia root rot.
soybean.harvest: 90-110 days; harvest when 95% pods turn brown/mature colour.

groundnut.season: Kharif (main) and Rabi/summer under irrigation in South India.
groundnut.climate: Warm climate 25-30 C, sensitive to frost and waterlogging, needs 50-125 cm rainfall.
groundnut.soil: Well-drained sandy loam, light in texture, pH 6.0-7.0; calcium availability important for pegging.
groundnut.sowing_time: Kharif: June-July; Rabi/summer: Jan-Feb (irrigated, South India).
groundnut.seed_rate: 100-120 kg pods/ha; 80-100 kg kernels/ha of bold varieties.
groundnut.spacing: 30 cm x 10 cm for spreading types; 30 cm x 15 cm for bunch types.
groundnut.irrigation: Rainfed in Kharif; summer/Rabi crop irrigated every 10-12 days, critical at pegging and pod development.
groundnut.fertilizer_schedule: 20:40:40 NPK kg/ha plus gypsum 400-500 kg/ha at flowering/pegging for pod filling.
groundnut.major_pests_diseases: Leaf miner, thrips, white grub; tikka leaf spot (early and late), rust, collar rot.
groundnut.harvest: 100-130 days; harvest when leaves yellow and pods show netted veins/darker inner shell colour.

mustard.season: Rabi oilseed crop, a major crop of Rajasthan, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh.
mustard.climate: Cool dry climate, 10-25 C, sensitive to frost at flowering and to high humidity (aphid buildup).
mustard.soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam, pH 6.0-7.5.
mustard.sowing_time: Mid-October to mid-November (irrigated); early October for rainfed/timely sowing.
mustard.irrigation: First irrigation at 30-35 DAS (rosette stage), second at 60-65 DAS (flowering/siliqua formation).
mustard.fertilizer_schedule: 80-100:40-60:40 NPK kg/ha plus 20-40 kg S/ha; half N and full P,K,S basal, remaining N at first irrigation.
mustard.major_pests_diseases: Mustard aphid, painted bug, sawfly; white rust, Alternaria blight, powdery mildew.
mustard.harvest: 125-145 days; harvest when 75% pods turn yellow-brown and seeds rattle.
mustard.improved_varieties: Pusa Bold, RH 749, Varuna, Giriraj, Pusa Mustard 30 (early).

potato.season: Rabi crop (main) in plains; also grown as Kharif/autumn crop in hills.
potato.climate: Cool climate, 15-20 C optimum for tuberization, sensitive to frost.
potato.soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter, pH 5.5-6.5, loose for tuber expansion.
potato.sowing_time: Mid-October to mid-November (plains); hills: March-April (spring) or July-Aug (autumn).
potato.seed_rate: 25-30 q/ha of whole/cut tubers (40-50 g seed pieces).
potato.irrigation: 6-8 irrigations at 8-10 day intervals; critical at stolonization and tuber bulking.
potato.fertilizer_schedule: 150-180:80-100:100-120 NPK kg/ha; full P,K and half N basal, remaining N at earthing-up (30 DAP).
potato.major_pests_diseases: Potato tuber moth, aphid (virus vector), cutworm; late blight, early blight, black scurf.
potato.harvest: 80-110 days; harvest after haulm senescence/desiccation, Jan-Feb.
potato.improved_varieties: Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Pukhraj, Kufri Bahar, Kufri Chipsona 1, Kufri Badshah.

tomato.season: Grown year-round; Kharif (June-July nursery), Rabi (Oct-Nov), summer (Feb-Mar).
tomato.climate: Warm season crop, 20-27 C optimum, sensitive to frost and prolonged high humidity.
tomato.soil: Well-drained sandy loam to loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.0.
tomato.sowing_time: Nursery raising with transplanting 25-30 days later; main season Oct-Nov (Rabi).
tomato.irrigation: Irrigate every 6-8 days; critical at flowering and fruit development; drip with mulching improves quality.
tomato.fertilizer_schedule: 100-120:60:60 NPK kg/ha; half N and full P,K basal, remaining N in two splits at flowering and fruit set.
tomato.major_pests_diseases: Fruit borer (Helicoverpa), whitefly (leaf curl vector), leaf miner; early blight, late blight, tomato leaf curl virus.
tomato.harvest: 60-80 days after transplanting; multiple pickings at 4-5 day intervals as fruits ripen.
tomato.expected_yield: 400-600 q/ha for hybrids under good management.
tomato.improved_varieties: Pusa Ruby, Arka Rakshak, Pusa Rohini, Himsona, Arka Vikas.

onion.season: Rabi (main, Nov-Dec transplant), also Kharif and late Kharif in different zones.
onion.climate: Cool climate for vegetative growth, warm dry weather needed for bulb maturity and curing.
onion.soil: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.5.
onion.sowing_time: Nursery: Oct-Nov (Rabi); transplanting 5-6 weeks later in December.
onion.irrigation: Irrigate every 7-10 days; stop irrigation 2-3 weeks before harvest for better curing and storage.
onion.fertilizer_schedule: 100:50:50 NPK kg/ha; half N and full P,K basal, remaining N in two splits at 30 and 45 DAT.
onion.major_pests_diseases: Thrips, onion maggot; purple blotch, Stemphylium blight, basal rot.
onion.harvest: 110-150 days after transplanting; harvest when 50-75% tops fall over and neck softens.
onion.improved_varieties: Pusa Red, Agrifound Dark Red, Bhima Super, N-53, Pusa Riddhi.

millets.season: Kharif crop; hardy and drought-tolerant, grown in rainfed marginal areas.
millets.climate: Warm climate, tolerant of drought and high temperature, needs 40-100 cm rainfall.
millets.soil: Wide adaptability - sandy loam to red/black soils of low fertility, pH 5.5-8.0.
millets.sowing_time: June-July with the onset of monsoon.
millets.seed_rate: 4-8 kg/ha for small millets such as finger millet, foxtail millet and kodo millet.
millets.spacing: 22.5-30 cm x 8-10 cm for line-sown/transplanted crop.
millets.irrigation: Mostly rainfed; one protective irrigation at grain filling improves yield if available.
millets.fertilizer_schedule: 40:20:20 NPK kg/ha; half N and full P,K basal, remaining N top-dressed at tillering.
millets.major_pests_diseases: Shoot fly, stem borer, aphid; blast, smut, downy mildew.
millets.harvest: 90-120 days; harvest when ear heads dry and grains harden.
millets.improved_varieties: Finger millet: GPU 28, VL Mandua 352; Foxtail millet: SiA 3085; Kodo millet: JK 137, JK 65.

barley.season: Rabi crop, a hardy cereal grown in marginal and saline/alkaline soils.
barley.climate: Cool dry climate, 12-25 C, more tolerant of drought, frost and salinity than wheat.
barley.soil: Wide adaptability including light, saline/alkaline and marginal soils, pH up to 9.5 tolerated.
barley.seed_rate: 100 kg/ha irrigated timely sown; 125 kg/ha late sown/rainfed.
barley.irrigation: 2-3 irrigations sufficient (more drought-hardy than wheat); critical at crown root initiation and jointing.
barley.fertilizer_schedule: 60-80:30-40:20 NPK kg/ha; half N and full P,K basal, remaining N at first irrigation (CRI stage).
barley.major_pests_diseases: Aphid, termite; yellow rust, covered smut, foliar blights.
barley.harvest: 120-140 days; harvest at physiological maturity, March-April.
